title: VHS Modpack
description: suggested modpack for the VHS minecraft server (season 1)
body:
# VHS MODPACK

This is the suggested modpack to use for the VHS server, it does not include very many qol mods, thats intentional so you can choose which ones you want yourself. This is not meant to be used for other servers..

Pack contents:
- all the mods from a regular performance pack
- shaders by default, turn it off before joining the world if your pc is bad.
- voxy/voxy server side so you can get 250 render distance without hurting fps. (the server usually only has 8-12 view distance so this mod is neccesary for the server to not look awful)


If you lag too much:
- turn off shaders
- go into voxy settings and find "pixels^2 of subdivision size" and increase that from the default (90) to 150+
